question:
A paper is folded and cut as shown in the following figures. How will it appear when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa7e3116a671214abe357b34deec18a5e135d5d9f918ac6324f9a3b2d2475386.png]
solution:
Here, we will unfold the page as it is folded. Firstly, we will unfold it from the right corner and then diagonally and last from the bottom left. And the paper will look like as given below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d113a7f418b640b294a68c5b1d215429eb2dd7da721e272cb7613937263fe123.png] 

Only, option(3), has the correct image of the unfolded paper

Hence, the correct answer is **option(3)**
